fire: Her lab builds microfluidic chips to sort cancer cells.

This course covers microfluidics and soft materials.

Their startup sells microfluidic cartridges to hospitals.
Droplet microfluidics lets chemists run many small reactions.
He wrote his thesis on microfluidic pumps.
